communication_listen_host.description: IP address the chunkserver listens on for incoming connections.

communication_listen_port.description: TCP port the chunkserver listens on for client and master communication.

chunks_path.description: Directory where chunk data files are stored. Must be a dedicated mount point with sufficient space.

workers.description: Number of worker threads to handle I/O. Increase if CPU utilization is low but I/O throughput is insufficient.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open files allowed per worker. Should be ≤ system ulimit.

client_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing idle client connections.

replication_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for chunk replication to complete.

checksum_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for checksum verification of a chunk.

checksum_read.description: Enable integrity verification (checksum) when reading chunks.

checksum_write.description: Enable integrity verification (checksum) when writing chunks.

masters.description: List of MooseFS Master servers the chunkserver registers with (host:port). At least one required.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of a MooseFS Master.

alternate_masters.description: Comma-separated list of fallback master addresses for high availability (not used in template unless uncommented).

chunkserver_id.description: Unique numeric or string ID for this chunkserver (auto-assigned if empty).

coremonitor_listen_host.description: Interface for the internal HTTP monitoring endpoint (e.g., for health checks).

coremonitor_listen_port.description: Port for the internal HTTP monitoring endpoint.
